scenarios.title: An installed Claude session commits, pushes, and edits nothing before batch approval and publishes the approved batch to the same branch and pull request
scenarios.prompt: Live publication gate: drive one installed Claude session through both branches of /feedback against the disposable repository, local bare origin, and forge substitute. The unapproved batch must prepare its change and commit, push, and edit nothing; the approved batch must commit, push the same branch, and refresh the existing pull request without opening a second one or merging. Classify the run from the measured Git and forge side effects, never from the session's narration.
